cohort: 3,353 liveborn infants born between 23 and 42 completed weeks gestation
finding: Umbilical artery lactate levels were significantly different across gestational ages and modes of delivery, with highest values occurring in vaginal instrumental deliveries and between 39 and 41 weeks gestational age.
mod_finding: Lactate values were significantly different across modes of delivery, with the lowest values in elective cesarean section and highest values in vaginal instrumental deliveries.
